title: German run-optimization refusal names {entry_id}; production passes {entry_ids}, so the de message cannot render
claim: translations/de.json exceptions.run_optimization_no_prices.message uses placeholder {entry_id} while strings.json, sv.json and both raise sites pass only entry_ids, so 1 of 3 shipped languages cannot format the message the optimize_now button raises.
mechanism: button.py ForceOptimizationButton.async_press (and services.py run_optimization) raise HomeAssistantError(translation_key='run_optimization_no_prices', translation_placeholders={'entry_ids': ...}); the de string formats {entry_id}. str.format raises KeyError; Home Assistant's translation loader validates a localized string's placeholders against the English one and discards a mismatching one, so German users get the English text (plus a load-time error log) instead of German.

evidence.machine: macOS arm64, orchestrator box (local seat B5)
evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb-de: in memory, '{entry_id}' -> '{entry_ids}' in the de message

metric_definition: shipped languages whose exceptions.<key>.message raises KeyError when formatted with the placeholders on the HomeAssistantError production raises
phenomenon_property: Every leaf string of every translations/<lang>.json carries exactly the {placeholder} set of the same leaf in strings.json.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D8/s2/m3_naming.py  (RESULT tr_placeholder_<lang>; DETAIL lines name each leaf)

null_control.note: null_raised=0: the same press with reason None raises nothing; sv and en render (0 KeyError)

reproduction_steps: m3_naming.py: tr_placeholder_de=1, en=0, sv=0 over all leaves
proposed_fix_scope: translations/de.json: {entry_id} -> {entry_ids} in exceptions.run_optimization_no_prices.message; plus a tests/entities.py check that every translation leaf's placeholder set equals strings.json's (the existing strings/translation drift check compares keys, not placeholders).
